goals: Allow villagers to acquire ordinary job-site POIs one block above an actually reachable adjacent standing position.
scope: A villager-only AcquirePoi job-site reachability fallback that preserves real POI positions, vanilla reservation, and normal profession assignment.

exclusions: POI registration, profession registration, fake/downshifted POIs, HOME/MEETING behavior, universal navigation changes, runtime deployment, and protected-profile access.

dependencies.reason: Target runtime and inspected AcquirePoi boundary.

state.milestone: Canary 1 implements a narrow villager job-site fallback after vanilla AcquirePoi path failure. Controlled vanilla GameTests passed for raised Cleric/Composter, normal-height control, two-block and sealed negatives, reservation capacity, and real-POI release; the Florist fixture awaits unavailable ignored C4/Ribbits/MRU local artifacts. Candidate remains NOT_DEPLOYED and RUNTIME_UNTESTED.
